subject.title: fix(core): harden CLI lifecycle and suite isolation

question: Should existing manifests with fixture retry counts above 10 remain valid, or may this release intentionally impose the new limit?
rationale: The branch changes an established accepted configuration value, and source inspection cannot determine whether the limit is an intentional product contract or an accidental upgrade break.

options.title: Preserve existing retry counts
options.body: Remove the fixed limit of 10 while retaining validation needed for safe integer and timer behavior.

options.title: Add an opt-in strict limit
options.body: Keep existing manifests compatible by default and expose the smaller bound only through an explicit strict configuration mode.

options.title: Approve the breaking cap
options.body: Keep the limit of 10 and add explicit upgrade documentation, migration guidance, and compatibility tests showing the intended failure.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing retry counts
recommendation.body: Remove the fixed limit of 10 while retaining validation needed for safe integer and timer behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored the current schema hardening and follow-up compatibility changes and is the strongest available routing candidate.
